evals.name: packages a snippet as a composable tool
evals.prompt: This awk one-liner for summarizing a column is the third time I've retyped it. Turn it into something I can just call by name.
evals.expected_output: Produces an executable with a shebang that reads stdin, writes stdout, and exits meaningfully.
assertions: The resulting tool reads from stdin so it composes in a pipeline.
The response makes the file executable and gives it a shebang.
